pages.title: Classic Roblox Noob Waving on a Spawn Platform Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a classic Roblox Noob waving from a spawn platform, with a smiling face, blocky limbs, and pixel-shaped clouds overhead. A starburst pattern covers the platform beneath the character, while round treetops and square ground tiles add smaller sections around the broad body shapes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Noob Dancing with Headphones Beside a Boombox Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox Noob dances beside a boombox in this printable coloring page, wearing large headphones with one arm raised and musical notes floating overhead. The tilted blocky pose, round speakers, and rectangular floor tiles give this coloring sheet a mix of large open spaces and smaller outlined details.

pages.title: Roblox Noob Driving a Go-kart Around a Race Track Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Roblox Noob driving a go-kart around a curved race track, with both hands on the wheel and checkered flags nearby. Broad tires and a low front bumper fill the foreground, while track barriers and sweeping motion lines frame the kart on this racing coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Noob Wearing a Spacesuit Beside a Rocket on the Moon Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Roblox Noob wearing a spacesuit beside a rocket on the moon, with a raised arm and Earth overhead. The helmet, chest controls, and knee panels add enclosed details to the character, while craters, scattered rocks, and stars surround the rocket on this space coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Noob Dressed as a Christmas Elf Carrying a Present Beside a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, a Roblox Noob dressed as a Christmas elf carries a ribbon-wrapped present beside a decorated tree topped with a star. Pointed trim edges the hat and outfit, while round ornaments, looping garlands, and more gifts add smaller shapes around the blocky figure on this Christmas coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Noob Climbing Steps on a Giant Noob in an Obby Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Roblox Noob climbing steps on a giant Noob in an obby, with rectangular footholds stretching up the larger figure. The small climber reaches toward the next block as clouds surround the giant's head and limbs. Broad rectangular body sections leave plenty of open space on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Noob in Jungle Coloring Page
pages.description: Roblox Noob smiles among tropical plants in this printable coloring page, his plain rectangular torso and limbs leaving broad open areas. Palm trunks, split leaves, rounded bushes, and grass tufts fill the jungle around the simple standing figure.

pages.title: Roblox Noob in Mountain Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Roblox Noob on a winding mountain trail beneath snowcapped peaks, with a curved smile and blocky arms. Scattered rocks and small pine trees surround the largely unpatterned figure and provide smaller background sections.

pages.title: Roblox Noob in Race Track Coloring Page
pages.description: Roblox Noob waves beside a race track in this printable coloring page, holding a checkered flag across his R shirt. Tire stacks, a distant finish structure, curved racing lanes, and a guardrail add geometric shapes around him.

pages.title: Roblox Noob in Camping Area Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Roblox Noob waving at a camping area, wearing a backpack with a rolled mat. A pitched tent, stone-ringed campfire, pine trees, and a winding path surround his simple R-shirted figure.

pages.title: Roblox Noob in Restaurant Coloring Page
pages.description: Roblox Noob sits behind a restaurant table in this printable coloring page, wearing a NOOB cap and OOF shirt beside a burger and drink. A food menu, bottles, window panes, and table grain supply smaller scene details.

pages.title: Roblox Noob on Tropical Island Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Roblox Noob on a tropical island, wearing a feathered hat, R shirt, and shorts. A palm tree, smiling sun, small starfish, grass tufts, and simple sea waves surround the blocky figure.

pages.title: Roblox Noob in City Plaza Coloring Page
pages.description: Roblox Noob stands smiling in a city plaza on this printable coloring page, with a plain torso, rectangular arms, and large outlined eyes. Square building windows, round-canopied trees, paving joints, and scattered stones form the uncluttered background.

pages.title: Roblox Noob in Crystal Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Roblox Noob inside a crystal cave, wearing a B shirt and shorts among clusters of pointed crystals. Long facets, triangular crystal tips, and curved rock walls create contrasting shapes around the smiling figure.

pages.title: Roblox Noob in School Hallway Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Roblox Noob in a school hallway wearing a hoodie with a large star and number 18 badge. Numbered lockers, a classroom door, drawstrings, and lace-up sneakers add smaller shapes around his plain face.

pages.title: Roblox Noob in Floating Island Coloring Page
pages.description: Roblox Noob stands on a floating island in this printable coloring page, with a rounded square head and plain block-shaped limbs. Layered rock edges, scattered stones, grass tufts, stars, and rounded clouds surround his broad unpatterned silhouette.
